name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that appears immediately on keyboard navigation. This ensures every interactive element is visible to keyboard users without cluttering the interface for mouse users. The trade-off is a slight increase in CSS complexity, but the benefit for accessibility far outweighs the cost.

name: Reader
text: The single high-contrast ring still forces sighted keyboard users to parse a moving target—especially when tabbing rapidly. A better alternative is a static, low-contrast ring that switches to high-contrast only after a short delay, reducing distraction while keeping focus visible. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and subjective frustration for both sighted and screen-reader users.
